title: The Sacred Bridge: Carta's Atlas of the Biblical World
author: Anson F. Rainey; R. Steven Notley
allowedUseNotes: Copyrighted reference atlas. Project stores its own summaries of identifications and routes only; no map reproductions.
summary: Standard scholarly atlas of biblical historical geography. Used here for site identifications (Besor, Gilboa, Beth-shan, Hebron, Jabesh-gilead candidates, Ziklag candidates), regional route reasoning, and the general Jerusalem-vicinity topography for the Valley of Rephaim/Baal-perazim (2 Samuel 5) — the valley's general location southwest of the City of David is standard atlas material; Baal-perazim's precise site within/near it is not independently fixed by this or any other card in this project's bibliography.
